action.instructions: Pilot a fixed-wing aircraft through the next numbered rectangular gate, then the remaining gates in order. Avoid the frame and ground. Maximize gates passed. Use the provided physical state and gate geometry, account for momentum and attitude response, start turns early and stop or reverse before overshooting. World +x follows the course, +y is LEFT, +z is UP. Euler pitch positive means nose DOWN and Euler roll negative means bank LEFT. Decisions last the stated duration. Pitch and bank commands execute simultaneously through the same attitude stabilizer. Neither nominal pitch nor wings-level locks altitude or heading. Banking may affect lift and vertical motion. Use all available relevant measurements; any constant-velocity crossing forecast is only an estimate, not a prediction of your next maneuver. The stabilizer has no gate knowledge. Base the choice on these specific state fields: `aircraft.position_world_xyz_m`, `aircraft.velocity_world_xyz_m_s`, `aircraft.roll_pitch_yaw_deg`, `next_gates[0].center_m`, `next_gates[0].relative_world_xyz_m`, `next_gates[0].half_width_m`, `next_gates[0].half_height_m`, and `controls`. The first item of `next_gates` is the immediate priority. Positive second component of `next_gates[0].relative_world_xyz_m` places that gate to your left, negative to your right. Positive third component places it above, negative below. Choose the maneuver from `simultaneous_axes` that best aligns current motion with this opening, accounting for velocity and attitude rather than position alone. When `navigation` is present, prioritize `navigation.immediate_gate.track_alignment_error_left_deg`, `navigation.immediate_gate.climb_alignment_error_up_deg`, their rates and the crossing clearances. A gate left of your POSITION can already be right of your MOTION DIRECTION. A positive bank turns left even if velocity is already aligned; continued bank can overshoot. Read `navigation.measurements.track_turn_rate_left_deg_s`, `navigation.measurements.bank_left_rate_deg_s`, `navigation.immediate_gate.height_error_up_m`, and the track/climb angular windows. Consider `navigation.leveling_estimate` when timing a bank release; it is an approximate empirical estimate, not a guaranteed result. The next gate transition describes upcoming geometry. All estimates are optional evidence, not control commands; make your own choice using measurements and inertia. When `navigation.target_update.changed_since_previous_decision` is true, the target has changed: reassess the current attitude and velocity for the new gate. The previous decision was for `navigation.target_update.previous_decision_gate_number`. Choose one joint pitch-and-bank maneuver from the 15 choices.

action.instructions: Fly through every numbered gate in order. Choose pitch and bank for the next interval. Read `target.horizontal_gap_left_deg` and `target.vertical_gap_up_deg`. These signed gaps are corrections to the nearest safe edge of the gate opening. Negative horizontal gap requires RIGHT correction; positive requires LEFT. Negative vertical gap requires descent; positive requires climb. Zero gap means this motion direction already passes inside the opening. Prioritize the opening windows over the center bearing, especially immediately before crossing: center angles can grow dramatically even while the crossing is safe. When absolute horizontal gap exceeds 15 degrees, a strong bank toward the needed correction is usually appropriate. Sustain it while the gap remains large; do not reverse simply because `motion.bank_left_deg` or `measured_rates.track_turn_rate_left_deg_s` already has the desired sign. Those are evidence your turn is working, not evidence the needed correction is complete. Use `target.horizontal_gap_if_leveled_now_left_deg`, `control.estimated_extra_turn_if_leveled_left_deg` and `measured_recent_responses` to reduce bank near alignment and avoid overshoot. Keep vertical motion within `target.climb_window_up_deg`; nominal level is trim, not altitude hold. Account for measured response lag rather than reversing pitch every interval. Use `following_transition` to prepare an exit toward the following gate while still clearing the current opening. Reassess immediately when `target_update.changed_since_previous_decision` is true. Upcoming gates remain valid outside the display camera. No image is supplied. Stay within `boundary.lateral_limits_world_m`. Estimates assume unchanged motion and are approximate. Choose one joint pitch-and-bank maneuver from the 15 choices.
